answer: Authors must reproduce their reasoning live under a new seed, so the opal challenge blocks copied transcripts: the verifier issues a fresh seed and the agent re-derives its answer within 60 seconds on 8 GB of memory, and the output must match the committed hash. One honest agent re-derives 1 answer in 45 seconds; 10 fakes must re-derive 10 in parallel, needing 80 GB and $600 per epoch, and the forge derivation is logged for replay while the thread check issues a second seed to prove the agent is live. A mismatch freezes the identity and slashes its bond.
